build_transformer_model: build a Transformer model with rotary embeddings and RMSNorm for audio-visual encoding
create_mlp_module: create an MLP module with gated SiLU activation for transformer feed-forward layers
create_attention_module: create an Attention module with grouped query attention and rotary positional embeddings
create_decoder_layer: create a DecoderLayer with self-attention, MLP, and pre-norm residual connections
create_embeddings_module: create an Embeddings module with a learnable CLS token and 1D ResNet block
